units.source_text: 但是，千重子很熟悉情况，她知道四条大街什么地方有什么彩车，

en.t: But Chieko knew the situation very well; she knew where the festival floats were along Shijo Avenue,

units.source_text: 哪条胡同又有哪些彩车，所以她统统浏览了一遍。

en.t: and which floats were in which side streets, so she went around and looked at them all.

units.source_text: 街上依然非常热闹，频频传来各种彩车的奏乐声。

en.t: The streets were still very lively, and the music from the various festival floats kept drifting through the air.
